# KnowML

> Machine learning and modern AI, from first principles to the 2026 frontier. Every section answers the same six questions; every runnable code block is executed in CI; numbers are derived on the page or attributed.

## Start here

- [Browse every section](https://knowml.vercel.app/sections.html)
- [Learning roadmaps](https://knowml.vercel.app/roadmaps.html)
- [Interactive labs](https://knowml.vercel.app/labs.html)
- [Site map (graph)](https://knowml.vercel.app/map.html)
- [Where to practise](https://knowml.vercel.app/practice.html)
- [Spaced-repetition drill](https://knowml.vercel.app/review.html)

## Foundations

- [Math & Stats Foundations](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/01-math-foundations.html): Linear algebra, probability, information theory.
- [Classical Supervised ML](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/02-classical-ml.html): Regression, trees, boosting, SVMs — still wins on tabular.
- [Unsupervised & Self-Supervised](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/03-unsupervised-self-supervised.html): Clustering, VAEs, contrastive learning. No labels.

## Neural Nets & Vision

- [Neural Network Fundamentals](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/04-neural-network-fundamentals.html): Backprop, activations, normalization, residuals.
- [CNNs & Vision Foundations](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/05-cnn-vision-foundations.html): Convolutions, ResNet, detection, segmentation.
- [Modern Vision Foundation Models](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/06-modern-vision-foundation-models.html): CLIP, SAM, ViT-based VLMs.

## Sequence, Attention & LLMs

- [Sequence Modeling Pre-Transformer](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/07-sequence-modeling-pre-transformer.html): RNNs, LSTMs, seq2seq — the bottleneck attention removed.
- [Attention & Transformers](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/08-attention-transformers.html): Query, key, value. The mechanism behind almost everything.
- [NLP Evolution](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/09-nlp-evolution.html): Bag-of-words to BERT to instruction tuning.
- [LLM Architecture & Training](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/10-llm-architecture-training.html): Decoder-only stacks, scaling laws, RLHF and DPO.

## Generative & Multimodal

- [RAG, Agents & Reasoning](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/11-rag-agents-reasoning.html): Why LLMs hallucinate, why retrieval helps, how agents plan.
- [Generative Models](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/12-generative-models.html): GANs, VAEs, diffusion.
- [Speech & Audio](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/13-speech-audio.html): ASR, TTS, speaker ID, real-time voice.
- [Multimodal AI](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/14-multimodal-ai.html): Fusing vision, audio and text into one system.

## Decision & Retrieval Systems

- [Reinforcement Learning](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/15-reinforcement-learning.html): MDPs, Q-learning, PPO — and what RLHF borrows.
- [Recommenders, Ranking & Search](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/16-recommenders-ranking-search.html): Retrieval, ranking, rerank — and the feedback loop that poisons it.
- [Time Series & Forecasting](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/17-time-series-forecasting.html): Why you cannot shuffle. Stationarity and honest backtests.
- [Graph ML](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/18-graph-ml.html): Message passing as the one primitive.

## Embodied & Frontier

- [Scientific & Structured AI](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/19-scientific-structured-ai.html): Equivariance, protein structure, PINNs.
- [3D, Spatial AI & Autonomous Driving](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/20-3d-spatial-autonomous-driving.html): SLAM, BEV, sensor fusion, closed-loop eval.
- [Robotics & Embodied AI](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/21-robotics-embodied-ai.html): VLA models, sim-to-real, diffusion policies.
- [World Models](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/22-world-models.html): Learned simulators and compounding error.

## Systems, Safety & Interview

- [Efficient AI & Systems](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/23-efficient-ai-systems.html): FlashAttention, quantization, parallelism.
- [ML Engineering & MLOps](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/24-mlops.html): Feature stores, drift, canary deploys.
- [Evaluation, Reliability & Safety](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/25-evaluation-reliability-safety.html): Calibration, hallucination, red-teaming, LLM-as-judge.
- [2026 Frontier Map](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/26-frontier-2026.html): Reasoning models, agents, world models.
- [Interview Mastery](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/27-interview-mastery.html): Question types, drills, how to structure an answer.
- [GPU Architecture, CUDA & Distributed Training](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/28-gpu-architecture-cuda-distributed.html): SIMT, warps, memory hierarchy, ring all-reduce.

## Hands-on

- [Fine-tuning LLMs in Practice](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/29-finetuning-llms.html): When not to. LoRA vs QLoRA by VRAM.
- [Running Models Locally](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/30-running-models-locally.html): Compute the VRAM yourself, then pick a format.
- [Preference Optimization: RLHF, DPO & GRPO](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/32-preference-optimization.html): Reward models, the DPO derivation, GRPO.

## Inference & Serving

- [LLM Inference &amp; Serving](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/31-llm-inference-serving.html): Prefill vs decode, TTFT, continuous batching.
- [LLM Inference at Scale](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/38-llm-inference-at-scale.html): Disaggregation, KV quantization, multi-LoRA, FP4.
- [Real-Time Voice AI](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/39-realtime-voice-ai.html): The turn-latency budget, endpointing, barge-in.
- [Diffusion &amp; Video Inference](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/40-diffusion-video-inference.html): Cutting the sampling loop, caching, video cost.

## The Labs

- [Backprop Lab](https://knowml.vercel.app/backprop-lab.html): Forward, backward, then gradients checked numerically.
- [Tokenizer Lab](https://knowml.vercel.app/tokenizer-lab.html): Build a BPE vocabulary merge by merge.
- [Attention Lab](https://knowml.vercel.app/attention-lab.html): Seven attention mechanisms on one worked example.
- [Sampling Lab](https://knowml.vercel.app/sampling-lab.html): Temperature, top-k and top-p on the same row.
- [Quantization Lab](https://knowml.vercel.app/quantization-lab.html): INT8 error cell by cell, and what one outlier costs.

## Model Atlas

- [Model Atlas: Language Models](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/33-model-atlas-language.html): Frontier, open-weight and on-device LLMs compared.
- [Model Atlas: Speech & Audio](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/34-model-atlas-speech-audio.html): STT, TTS, separation, diarization — with the metrics explained.
- [Model Atlas: Vision & Generative Media](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/35-model-atlas-vision-generative.html): VLMs, detection, OCR, image and video generation.

## Grand Challenges

- [The Millennium Prize Problems](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/36-millennium-prize-problems.html): Seven problems, $1M each, six still open.
- [AI in Industry: What It Is Actually Solving](https://knowml.vercel.app/topics/37-ai-in-industry.html): AlphaFold's Nobel — and the claims that did not survive.
